originality.rationale: The 2026 source gives a qualitative cycle-existence criterion, and the 2012 source handles commutative two-loops. Neither discusses rank-stratified period-two points in noncommutative matrix rings or the fixed-q quarter-rank theta limit. The published matrix zero-divisor result supplies the standard square-zero flag multiplicity but does not count Vieta two-cycle points or their limiting rank law. A published zero-product pair result AB=0 has a distinct parameter locus, so its half-rank distribution cannot simply be substituted for B^2=0 and AB=-B. The novel rank-limit theorem was proved independently by product estimates, and no searched source asserts that limit. Unindexed-priority risk is recorded; no assertion of exhaustive search is made.
